// @vitest-environment jsdom
// Drives an OLDER build's real app (this file is copied into that build's tests/ folder, as
// amnesicDrive.dom.test.jsx) over storage as THIS build leaves it, and writes down what the older
// build made of it and what it left behind (run with OLDER_BUILD=<tag> AMNESIC_OUT=<file>). The
// record is tests/fixtures/olderBuilds/amnesic-<build>.json; tests/sessionAmnesic.olderBuilds.test.js
// holds this build to it.
//
// The older build keeps a preset's Amnesic switch as a boolean on the shared preset registry, puts
// it back to `saved.amnesic` (its saved-defaults snapshot) at every fresh open, and knows nothing of
// a three-way value, of `amnesicMode`, or of the session's own record (`cg-amnesic-v1`).
import { describe, it, afterEach } from 'vitest'
import { render, screen, cleanup, fireEvent, act } from '@testing-library/react'
import { writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { App } from '../src/main.jsx'
import { usePresets } from '../src/store/presets.js'
import { useSettings, SETTINGS_DEFAULTS } from '../src/store/settings.js'
import { useModePrefs } from '../src/store/modePrefs.js'
import { useProgress } from '../src/store/progress.js'
import { useUserDefaults } from '../src/store/userDefaults.js'
import { setPresetAmnesic, createPreset } from '../src/store/presetControl.js'
import { readDate, correctDayName } from './helpers/modeScreen.jsx'

const BUILD = process.env.OLDER_BUILD
const PREFS = { flashMs: 800, blitzSec: 60, blitzQSec: 10, aoxN: '10' }
// A settings snapshot the questions can be read and answered under (numeric-ymd, Gregorian only).
const READABLE = {
  ...SETTINGS_DEFAULTS,
  randomFormat: false,
  dateFormat: 'numeric-ymd',
  minY: 1583,
  maxY: 10000,
}
const PROGRESS = 'cg-progress-v1'
const DEFAULTS = 'cg-userdefaults-v1'
const REGISTRY = 'cg-presets-v1'
const SETTINGS = 'cg-settings-v1'

function mountApp() {
  const root = document.createElement('div')
  root.id = 'root'
  document.body.appendChild(root)
  return render(<App />)
}
function unmountApp() {
  cleanup()
  document.getElementById('root')?.remove()
}
const isHidden = (el) => {
  for (let n = el; n; n = n.parentElement) if (n.style && n.style.display === 'none') return true
  return false
}
const visibleButton = (name) => screen.getAllByRole('button', { name }).find((b) => !isHidden(b))
const tap = (el) =>
  act(() => {
    fireEvent.pointerDown(el)
    fireEvent.click(el, { detail: 1 })
  })
const answerRight = () => tap(visibleButton(correctDayName(readDate())))

// A page load of the older build: every store reads storage again, then the app mounts (its boot
// effect is what puts each preset's switch back to its saved default on a fresh open).
function load() {
  act(() => {
    usePresets.persist.rehydrate()
    useSettings.persist.rehydrate()
    useModePrefs.persist.rehydrate()
    useProgress.persist.rehydrate()
    useUserDefaults.persist.rehydrate()
  })
  mountApp()
}
const put = (key, state, version) => localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify({ state, version }))
const stored = (key, area = localStorage) => JSON.parse(area.getItem(key) ?? 'null')
// Start from a device this build has been used on: readable settings, 3 saved Classic answers.
function seedDevice() {
  localStorage.clear()
  sessionStorage.clear()
  put(SETTINGS, READABLE, 4)
  put(
    PROGRESS,
    {
      stats: {
        classic: { played: 3, good: 3, streak: 3, best: 3, times: [] },
        flash: { played: 0, good: 0, streak: 0, best: 0, times: [] },
        dedDay: { played: 0, good: 0, streak: 0, best: 0, times: [] },
        dedMonth: { played: 0, good: 0, streak: 0, best: 0, times: [] },
        dedYear: { played: 0, good: 0, streak: 0, best: 0, times: [] },
      },
      blitzBest: {},
      suddenBest: {},
      suddenAmBest: {},
      aoxBest: {},
    },
    5,
  )
}
// What the older build shows and where one answered question went.
function playOne() {
  tap(visibleButton('New'))
  answerRight()
  return {
    flag: usePresets.getState().presets.find((p) => p.id === usePresets.getState().activeId)
      .amnesic,
    permanentPlayed: stored(PROGRESS).state.stats.classic.played,
    sessionPlayed: stored(PROGRESS, sessionStorage)?.state?.stats?.classic?.played ?? null,
  }
}

const out = {}
afterEach(unmountApp)

describe(`amnesic drive — ${BUILD}`, () => {
  // A. A FRESH OPEN over a saved-defaults snapshot in this build's spelling, for each value.
  for (const mode of ['off', 'stats', 'full'])
    it(`a fresh open over a snapshot saved as ${mode}`, () => {
      seedDevice()
      put(
        DEFAULTS,
        { saved: { settings: READABLE, prefs: PREFS, amnesic: mode !== 'off', amnesicMode: mode } },
        3,
      )
      load()
      const played = playOne()
      out[`freshOpen:${mode}`] = {
        ...played,
        registry: stored(REGISTRY)?.state ?? null,
        savedAfter: stored(DEFAULTS).state.saved,
      }
    })

  // B. The spelling this build did NOT choose — the value in the boolean's own field — to have on
  // record what the older build would have made of it.
  for (const mode of ['off', 'stats', 'full'])
    it(`a fresh open over a snapshot whose amnesic field is the string ${mode}`, () => {
      seedDevice()
      put(DEFAULTS, { saved: { settings: READABLE, prefs: PREFS, amnesic: mode } }, 3)
      load()
      out[`freshOpen:stringField:${mode}`] = playOne()
    })

  // C. The older build SAVES defaults over a snapshot this build wrote (its own Save Defaults call).
  it('its Save Defaults over a Stats Only snapshot', () => {
    seedDevice()
    put(
      DEFAULTS,
      { saved: { settings: READABLE, prefs: PREFS, amnesic: true, amnesicMode: 'stats' } },
      3,
    )
    load()
    const loaded = stored(DEFAULTS).state.saved
    act(() => {
      useUserDefaults.getState().saveDefaults({
        settings: { ...READABLE },
        prefs: PREFS,
        amnesic: usePresets.getState().presets[0].amnesic,
      })
    })
    out.saveDefaultsOverStatsOnly = { loaded, saved: stored(DEFAULTS).state.saved }
  })

  // D. Its load of an OLDER-version snapshot carrying this build's field (its migrate re-saves).
  it('its migration of a v2 snapshot that carries amnesicMode', () => {
    seedDevice()
    const { dotRotation: _drop, ...pre } = READABLE
    put(
      DEFAULTS,
      {
        saved: {
          settings: { ...pre, rotateDots: true },
          prefs: PREFS,
          amnesic: true,
          amnesicMode: 'stats',
        },
      },
      2,
    )
    load()
    out.migratedV2 = stored(DEFAULTS)
  })

  // E. THE HAND-OVER: a guest is playing in the older build with its switch on. What is on the
  // device and in the session at that moment is what this build's first load (the update reload)
  // finds.
  it('a guest session: the switch turned on, one answer', () => {
    seedDevice()
    load()
    act(() => {
      setPresetAmnesic(1, true)
    })
    const played = playOne()
    out.guestSession = {
      ...played,
      registry: stored(REGISTRY).state,
      sessionKeys: Object.keys({ ...sessionStorage }).sort(),
    }
  })

  // F. A registry as this build writes it (every preset carrying the boolean), with one preset's
  // flag left TRUE by an earlier older-build session — at a fresh open, and at a reload.
  it('a registry this build wrote, with a stale flag — fresh open, then a reload', () => {
    seedDevice()
    put(
      REGISTRY,
      {
        presets: [
          { id: 1, name: 'Preset 1', amnesic: true },
          { id: 2, name: 'Guest', amnesic: false },
        ],
        activeId: 1,
        nextId: 3,
        openInPreset: 'last',
      },
      1,
    )
    load()
    const fresh = playOne()
    unmountApp()
    // …and the same registry met by a RELOAD of the older build (its session already open).
    put(
      REGISTRY,
      {
        presets: [
          { id: 1, name: 'Preset 1', amnesic: true },
          { id: 2, name: 'Guest', amnesic: false },
        ],
        activeId: 1,
        nextId: 3,
        openInPreset: 'last',
      },
      1,
    )
    load()
    out.staleFlag = { freshOpen: fresh, reload: playOne() }
  })

  // G. THE ONE SEQUENCE LEFT OPEN: this build has a preset on Full (or Stats Only) for a guest — its
  // value is in the session's own record, the registry flag is untouched — and the OLDER build is
  // then loaded in the same tab, as a reload.
  it('this build’s session value, then the older build loaded in the same tab', () => {
    seedDevice()
    load() // the older build's own fresh open marks the session open
    unmountApp()
    sessionStorage.setItem('cg-amnesic-v1', JSON.stringify({ 1: 'full' }))
    sessionStorage.setItem(
      PROGRESS,
      JSON.stringify({ state: { stats: { classic: { played: 9, good: 9, streak: 9, best: 9, times: [] } } }, version: 5 }),
    )
    load()
    out.sameTabAfterThisBuild = playOne()
  })

  // H. A preset it creates, and what it writes for the ones it did not touch.
  it('the registry it writes when it creates a preset', () => {
    seedDevice()
    put(
      REGISTRY,
      {
        presets: [
          { id: 1, name: 'Preset 1', amnesic: false },
          { id: 2, name: 'Guest', amnesic: true },
        ],
        activeId: 1,
        nextId: 3,
        openInPreset: 'last',
      },
      1,
    )
    sessionStorage.setItem('cg-browsing-session-v1', '1') // a reload: no put-back at this load
    load()
    act(() => {
      createPreset('Third')
    })
    out.createdPreset = stored(REGISTRY).state
  })

  it('writes the record', () => {
    writeFileSync(process.env.AMNESIC_OUT, JSON.stringify(out, null, 2) + '\n')
  })
})
